purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Kacheliba Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved), then re-cropped and upscaled around the TOTAL row for digit-level confirmation. This constituency's downloaded Form 34B is a 4-page document; the page header banner reads 'CON 131 03/18' (page 3 of 4 served by the portal in this download, ending in the TOTAL row highlighted in green; page 4 is the closing agent-signature/handover page). The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election session handshake (id=5).

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (KACHELIBA, code 131, county WEST POKOT code 024) was read from the declaration-page header and cross-checked against the visible 'CON 131' banner marker printed on the TOTAL-row page itself before this row was accepted.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

note: Although the source header marks this page as sheet '03/18' (suggesting a much larger multi-sheet form), the printed TOTAL row's Registered Voters figure (51,146) reconciles exactly to the governed P23 constituency denominator, and the four candidate cells sum exactly to the printed Total Valid Votes figure (41,262). This evidence establishes a source-verified row under the extraction contract. Canonical materialization is authorized only by the separate governed promotion tranche in data/p23/form34b-turnout-promotion-contract.json.
